bla_old.text: My grandad was an ironworker, my dad was a miner and I was a miner. My son sells insurance. He says it's very similar, with fewer hats.
They say there's a quiet hill above the town where you can still hear Blaenavon thinking.

bla_kid.text: I went down Big Pit on a school trip. They took all our batteries off us at the lamp room. The guide said one spark in a gassy pit would be the end of the school trip. And possibly the school.
It's dark. It's really, really dark. Don't bring a torch. You won't be allowed.

bla_walker.text: There's a footpath up to Keepers Pond and the Garn. On a clear day you can see across to the Brecon Beacons. On a normal day you can see your own boots.
The old tramroads cross the hills like pencil lines. You can follow them for miles, and the ponies' hooves wore the stones smooth.
